overview.description: The USCF Energy Commodity Strategy Absolute Return Fund (USE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in multi-strategy alternatives. The fund is an actively managed fund that provides exposure to oil, petroleum, and natural gas through long, short, or spread positions in energy-related derivatives and other commodity-linked investments. USE was launched on May 4, 2023 and is issued by Marygold.
